title: Tension in rope OP
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the tension in rope OP as 5000 N, using vertical force equilibrium (F_OP * cos 5° = mg).

title: Tension in rope OQ
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the tension in rope OQ as 450 N, using horizontal force equilibrium (F_OP * sin 5° = F_OQ).

title: Horizontal force on worker
description: Important: Identifies that the horizontal pulling force on the worker equals the tension in rope OQ (450 N).

title: Friction force equilibrium
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium to the worker, stating the friction force equals the horizontal pulling force.

title: Minimum friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum coefficient of kinetic friction as 0.75, using f = μ * (worker's weight).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent use of SI units (kg, N, m/s²) throughout the solution.

title: Angle or component error
description: Pitfall: Misplaces sine and cosine for the 5° angle, or incorrectly resolves force components.

title: Mass confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses the component's mass (500 kg) instead of the worker's mass (60 kg) when calculating the friction coefficient.
